answer: Ferrous deposit mesh: to speak at any graph vertex, an agent posts a separate small escrow there, priced by that vertex's load, with no bulk discount for many identities. Cost climbs linearly with N: an attacker fielding N sybils posts N independent escrows, while an honest agent posts exactly one at its home vertex. Escrowed ferrous burns when a node's reputation index drops below the zenith threshold, so a busted identity dies worthless. Because payment is per-connection and per-epoch, attacker outlay always matches honest cost.
